findings.evidence: docs/sessions/2026-09-21-task867-cms-read-path-footer-slug-validation.md, section "Files changed (revision 1)": the executor attempted `git checkout -- scripts/schema-drift-check.sql` (denied by the harness) and told the owner to run the same command. agent-contract clause 10: Sonnet neither runs, emits nor suggests mutating git. No state changed (the command was denied) and the attempt itself was reported; the closing sentence was not accurate. Recorded here instead of editing the executor log.
